instruction: A candid medium over-the-shoulder photograph captures a moment inside a martial arts studio with a plain white wall and gray concrete floor. On the left foreground, the dark-haired student in a black gi (R5) is positioned with their back partially to the camera, standing in a defensive stance facing towards the right. On the right side of the frame, the bearded instructor with a patterned headband (R6) wearing a black gi stands in a sparring stance, facing left with his fists raised defensively. The two martial artists are engaged in a focused training session, with bright, even indoor lighting illuminating the scene and casting soft shadows on the floor.
